items.description:
A conversation visible in the combined inbox. Private access is
checked live from the explicit participant pair plus a currently shared
family; it is never a persisted creation-time grant.

kind.description:
`FAMILY` is one existing family chat; `PRIVATE` is a canonical
one-to-one direct-message pair with explicit participants.
kind.title: ChatConversationKind

group.description: Present for `FAMILY`, absent or null for `PRIVATE`.

participants.description: Current family members for `FAMILY`, the two explicit users for `PRIVATE`.

items.description: A member with whom the caller currently shares at least one family.
items.title: ChatEligiblePerson

allOf.description:
A privacy-safe inbox summary of the newest message. For an unsupported
`encryption` marker, `content` is null and `hasAttachment` is false.

encryption.description:
Open encryption compatibility marker. Current servers use
`none`; this field does not mean encryption is a shipped user
feature.

allOf.title: ChatConversationLastMessage

items.title: ChatConversation
